title: wtm run config
description: Schema for .wtm/run.toml — declares jobs (services and tasks) and profiles that compose them.

port_offset_block.description: Spacing between two worktrees' ports. Each worktree holds an ordinal (0 for the main checkout) and every declared base port is shifted by ordinal x this block. Two base ports must not differ by a multiple of it: 3000 and 3010 with a block of 10 collide on the second worktree, while 5434/5435/5436 never do. Defaults to 10.

job.description: List of jobs the project can run.

name.description: Job name. Must be unique across all [[job]] entries in this file (enforced at load time). Referenced from profiles and from `wtm run start|stop|logs`.

kind.description: service = long-running process (pnpm dev, docker compose). task = one-shot script (pnpm migrate, pnpm seed) that must exit 0 before the profile continues.

cmd.description: Command to start the job, run as a `/bin/sh` line: quotes, `&&`, pipes, redirections and globs all mean what they mean in a terminal, and `${VAR}` expands from the job's environment — including the ports declared below. Write `pnpm dev --port ${PORT}` for a server that only takes its port as a CLI flag.

stop.description: Optional stop command. When set on a service, marks it as detached: wtm waits for `cmd` to exit on start (e.g. `docker compose up -d`) and uses `stop` to shut it down later. A `/bin/sh` line like `cmd`, run with the same environment and the same resolved ports. Tasks cannot have a stop command.

cwd.description: Working directory relative to the worktree root. Defaults to the worktree root.

ports.description: Base ports this job binds, as ENV_VAR = port. wtm injects ENV_VAR = port + WTM_PORT_OFFSET, so the main checkout keeps the declared port and every other worktree gets a free one. Write the command to read the variable (PORT for a dev server) or template it into docker-compose ("${DB_PORT:-5432}:5432", the default keeping the file usable without wtm).

then.description: Tasks cannot declare a stop command.

profile.description: Named groups of jobs run together via `wtm run up [profile]`.

name.description: Profile name. Must be unique across all [[profile]] entries in this file (enforced at load time). Used as the argument to `wtm run up <name>`.

jobs.description: Ordered list of job names. Jobs run sequentially: tasks block, services start in the background. The same job cannot appear twice.

default.description: If true, this profile runs when `wtm run up` is invoked without a profile argument. At most one profile in the file can have default = true (enforced at load time).

env_port.description: Links a .env key to a declared port. wtm rewrites the port inside that key's value for each worktree, leaving the rest of the value untouched — so a hard-coded host:port in a URL follows the worktree's offset.

file.description: The .env target holding the key, as configured under [env] in .wtm.toml (e.g. ".env", "apps/web/.env").

key.description: The .env key whose value carries the port.

port.description: The port variable declared in a job's `ports` table, whose base is looked for inside the value.
